name: 涅格
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:3287
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 204）｜中（白骸骨匠会）｜照常｜5档｜8803 年凝名的撼世，英雄往上不看家境，给骨匠会顶上的那一身：废都残铁拿白骨接成的鳞甲、骨符护臂，招牌是犬眠钩和指上长出的白骨枝；魔族不烧魔晶，光只放在骨刻上。
who: Neg, called the Wolf-Forger, a bone-demon of the White Bones who built the first iron wolf, a legend who has looked twenty-five or twenty-six ever since the night his name was made at about three hundred years old: about 187 cm, level shoulders, long limbs. Pale bone-white skin often dusted with iron filings; a thin natural ridge of white bone runs under each row of knuckles. Indigo-blue long hair tied at the nape. Light orange eyes. Two bone horns grow from the edges of his forehead and lie back close along the head: the two bone horns sweep straight backward and lie flat along the sides of the head, NOT pointing upward. The left sleeve cuff (on the viewer's right when he faces us) was once torn by a dog long dead; he stitched it shut so the stitching keeps the shape of the tooth marks. A handsome face, a straight nose; gentle with bones, short with people.
build: 187 cm, tall and long-limbed: level, lean shoulders, a flat chest, long arms and legs.
palette: bone white, indigo blue, iron grey, light orange, a little frayed rope brown
casual: His bone-workshop clothes: a fitted long-sleeved work coat of heavy dark iron-grey wool with a plain turned-down collar and simple round bone buttons down the front, NOT a stand collar, NOT horizontal toggle loops or frog fastenings, Western cut, NOT a mandarin collar, NOT frog buttons or knotted cord fastenings, the left cuff with its stitched tooth-mark tear, a thick leather bone-wright's apron, dark trousers and heavy boots. In his right hand he holds the Dog-Sleep Hook, a long hook of white bone whose haft is wound round with a frayed dog's rope that was bitten through. A slightly bored, quiet look.
private: At day's end, alone: a loose long-sleeved undyed grey linen shirt, dark trousers, soft boots, the indigo hair half loose. He holds a short length of bitten-through dog rope in both hands, winding it slowly round his fingers. A tired, soft look.
battle: Raising the first iron wolf as a legend of the bone-demons: a long fitted coat of dark iron scale salvaged from a fallen city, every plate bound to the next by grown white bone, a tall collar of interlocked white vertebrae, sculpted pauldrons of pale beast skull ridged with dark iron, bone-carved bracers on both forearms hung with rows of bone charms whose cut script glows a faint orange; the left cuff still stitched with the tooth-mark tear. White bone branches sprout from the fingertips and knuckle ridges of his raised left hand, reaching forward. In his right hand the long white Dog-Sleep Hook, its haft wound with the bitten rope, its point lit pale orange. A level, cold, absorbed look.
formal: Before the bone-wrights' guild: a long charcoal wool coat closing down the front with polished bone buttons, fitted sleeves, the left cuff with its stitched tooth marks left as it is, a narrow undyed grey sash, a single carved bone tag of the guild on the chest, the hair tied neatly at the nape, the bone hook hanging at the hip. He stands straight with the hands at his sides, a cool, impatient look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the light orange eyes lowered toward something he touches just below the frame, a gentle, absorbed look, the mouth closed. Cold grey ash light from above and a faint orange glow from the bone script at his wrist. Foreground blur: drifting grey ash and the frayed dog rope on the bone hook's haft. He wears the iron-grey work coat with the stitched cuff.

name: 札恩
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:3248
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 205）｜贫（机兵棚里长大的孤儿）｜照常｜5档｜围狼营三天到撼世，英雄往上不看家境；上弦场最精的一身：山铜片加环形回路、随哨音亮的晶石护臂，人轻装，重的交给三千台机兵，招牌是蓝垒哨。
who: Zahn, called the Whistle of the Machines, a dog-eared beastfolk winder raised under the winch frames of the southern wall, a legend who has looked thirty ever since the night his name was made: about 181 cm, narrow shoulders, long legs, arms made solid by hauling armour plates. Warm gold short hair. Violet eyes. A pair of soft drooping dog ears; a small notch is missing from the right ear (on the viewer's left when he faces us), cut by a frame edge when he fell asleep under it as a child. The Blue-Rampart Whistle is always three brass pipes bound side by side, one long and two short. He has NO human ears, only the two drooping dog ears, the right dog ear (on the viewer's left) with a small notch cut out of its edge; no earrings. His dog tail is always tucked away inside his long coat so it never strays into a turning winch. A lean, clean-cut face with a shallow dimple on the left cheek when he smiles. A warm, patient air; he looks at a machine's knees before its face.
build: 181 cm, lean and long-legged: narrow shoulders, solid working arms, a flat chest and a light frame.
palette: warm gold, violet, brass, grey-blue, worn leather brown
casual: His winding-yard clothes: a long patched grey-brown wool coat that is too short in the sleeves, an old man's coat he never gave up, worn over a grey-blue shirt with the sleeves bound at the forearm with copper wire, a winder's leather apron with a row of small chest pockets holding wrenches and brass tuning pins, sturdy trousers and boots, the tail tucked inside the coat. In his right hand the Blue-Rampart Whistle, three brass pipes bound side by side, one long and two short, NOT two pipes. A friendly, attentive look.
private: Off shift: the short-sleeved old coat thrown over his shoulders like a blanket, a loose undyed linen shirt, rolled trousers, soft shoes. He holds a heel of bread in one hand, a sleepy, relaxed half-smile with the left dimple.
battle: Leading three thousand clockwork soldiers as a legend of the wall: a long fitted grey-blue field coat of the winding corps reinforced with overlapping orichalcum plates at the chest and shoulders, every plate engraved with ring-shaped rune circuits glowing blue, a high stiff collar lined with brass, crystal-set bracers on both forearms whose blue crystals pulse in time with the whistle, a winder's belt of small pockets with brass tuning pins, the tail tucked inside the coat. He raises the three-piped Blue-Rampart Whistle (three brass pipes bound side by side, one long and two short) to his lips with the right hand, rings of blue light spreading from it across his plates, the left hand lifted open to signal. A calm, focused look.
formal: At the muster of the southern wall: the corps' grey-blue coat brushed clean with every button done up, fresh copper wire at the cuffs, a single small brass plate of the winding yard on the chest, the tail neatly tucked away, the three-piped whistle on a cord at his neck. He stands straight with the ears slightly lifted, a polite, faintly shy smile.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the violet eyes looking a little past the viewer, the three-piped brass whistle (three pipes bound side by side, one long and two short) just touching his lips; only the two drooping dog ears, NO human ear, no earring. Cold dusk light from one side and a blue glow of rune circles from below. Foreground blur: the soft-focus brass knee joint of a clockwork soldier and a small wooden block. He wears the short-sleeved old grey-brown coat.

name: 蒂茉·铃尾
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:3170
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 203，9318 年凝名时极境，约 9400 年到传奇）｜中（铃尾信使家）｜轻装（要跑、要听地声，不披重甲、不拿兵器）｜5档｜画的是到传奇以后，英雄往上不看家境；照顶上一档给附魔软皮加山铜薄片的信使半甲、晶石护臂，铃尾的绳扣八字照留，招牌是脚下的白印风痕和包着布的铃。
who: Timo of the Bell-tail courier family, called Ahead of the Fire, a rabbit-eared beastfolk courier who outran the news along the southern wall, a legend who keeps the face she had at twenty-two: small and quick, about 156 cm. Short peach-pink hair. Blue-green eyes. Long rabbit ears with a ring of white fur at the tips; when she runs hard she presses them down into her hood. A round-cheeked, bright-eyed face; her two front teeth are a little long when she grins. Sturdy runner's calves. Her right boot has been resoled with two more layers than the left. A small silver bell at her waist completely wrapped and tied up in soft cream cloth, a little cloth bundle, so it cannot ring over the sound of the road; the bell itself is NOT visible. An honest, quick air, frightened and going anyway. No jewelry.
build: 156 cm, small and quick: light shoulders, strong runner's legs, a C-cup, a slim waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: peach pink, sea blue-green, courier grey, white fur, a little silver
casual: Bell-tail courier dress: a grey leather short-armour jerkin over a grey wool tunic, a cord belt with a ring of rope loops at the waist, a coil of rope slung from behind across the body and coiled in a figure eight, a grey hood with openings for the ears hanging down her back, close-fitting dark leggings, soft courier boots with the right sole thicker; the silver bell at the waist wrapped out of sight in a small tied bundle of cream cloth, no bell showing, a flat letter bag at the hip. She stands light on her toes, ready to go, a bright, eager look.
private: Off the road: a long-sleeved soft blue-green wool dress to the shins, thick knitted stockings, felt slippers. She holds a pair of worn socks and a darning needle, a sleepy, cheerful grin showing the long front teeth.
battle: Running ahead of the fire as a legend courier: a fitted grey courier's half-armour of supple enchanted leather and thin orichalcum plates over chest and back, a white rune line glowing along each edge, the Bell-tail rope loops at the waist and the rope coiled behind in a figure eight, a short grey hooded cape with the long ears pressed flat into the hood, crystal-set bracers on both forearms glowing pale, light greaves over the courier boots, the silver bell at the waist wrapped out of sight in a small tied bundle of cream cloth, no bell showing. Milky-white wind marks swirl around her ankles and boots. She leans forward in mid-stride, one hand raised to signal, no weapon. A frightened but resolute look.
formal: On the day the couriers ride out: a clean grey courier's jacket with silver buttons closing down the front, the Bell-tail rope sash knotted in a neat figure eight, the grey hood lowered to free the ears, the bell still wrapped out of sight in a small tied bundle of cream cloth at the waist, no bell showing, polished boots. She stands straight with the ears up, a proud, slightly embarrassed smile.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the blue-green eyes wide and looking past the viewer, the long ears lifted and turned toward a sound off to the side, the mouth closed. Cold first light before dawn from one side and a faint warm red glow on the horizon behind her. Foreground blur: milky-white wind marks lifting off a stone path and a strand of the soft cloth around her bell. She wears the grey courier jerkin with the hood lowered.

name: 菲莉帕·白鹿
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:3209
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 204）｜中（白鹿家在白鹿驿管车的一支）｜照常（护车的人，穿得实用）｜5档｜双崖口第九天过两百，英雄往上不看家境；给白石色的附魔半身甲、崖层样的肩甲，自己缝的白鹿纹接到罩衣上，招牌是掌上的白石纹和白隘短剑。
who: Philippa of the White Stag family, called the Door on the Road of Retreat, a human carter-guard who held a mountain pass open with her two hands, a legend whose face stays as it was at thirty-eight: about 170 cm, broad-shouldered and sturdy. Deep violet long hair coiled low at the nape. Gold-brown eyes. A light scatter of freckles across the bridge of the nose. A mature woman's long face with relaxed brows; she looks people straight in the eye. Rough, strong hands. A short sword at her belt whose scabbard mouth has been worn smooth against cart shafts. A steady, practical, warm air of a woman who always checks the last cart herself. No jewelry.
build: 170 cm, sturdy and capable: broad shoulders and back, strong rough hands, a D-cup, a firm waist and full hips.
palette: grey-green, deep violet, stone white, gold-brown, worn scabbard brown
casual: Her road clothes: an old grey-green riding coat to mid-thigh, fitted and closing down the front with buttons, on the chest a white stag emblem she stitched on herself, its two antlers sewn unevenly in length; a cream linen shirt, a wide belt with the short sword White Pass at the hip, its scabbard mouth worn smooth; riding trousers and tall boots; one coat pocket bulging with a spare loaf of bread. One hand rests on the sword hilt, a level, attentive look.
private: At home in the White Stag post-house: a long-sleeved soft brown wool dress, a knitted grey shawl, the hair loosened into a low braid, house shoes. She holds a counting slate and a stub of chalk, a quiet, tired, kind look.
battle: Holding the pass as a legend of the wall: over the grey-green riding coat a fitted half-armour of pale enchanted plate the colour of white stone, its edges veined with glowing white rock lines, a broad gorget, heavy pauldrons shaped like layered cliff ledges, rune-lit vambraces, the hand-stitched white stag with uneven antlers re-sewn onto a short white tabard over the breastplate. Both bare hands are thrust out to the sides, palms open, white stone veins glowing across the palms and wrists. The short sword White Pass, a line of white stone inlaid along its back, rides in its scabbard at the hip. A hoarse, unyielding look.
formal: At the White Stag house on a muster day: the old grey-green riding coat brushed clean with every button done up, the hand-stitched white stag on the chest, a deep violet scarf at the throat, the hair coiled neatly low, polished boots, the short sword at the hip. She stands straight, a grave, open look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the gold-brown eyes looking straight at the viewer as if counting heads, the mouth closed, a strand of violet hair loose at the temple. Warm dusk light from one side and a cold white glow of stone veins from her raised palm. Foreground blur: drifting embers and the canvas edge of a cart awning. She wears the grey-green riding coat with the uneven white stag.

name: 茹瑟娅
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:3326
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 202）｜世家（绯宴）｜医者（喂血水救人，不拿兵器）｜5档（医者那一路）｜两千碗那一夜到撼世，绯宴的料子足；她是救人的，不披重甲，给这一纪绯宴顶上的战袍和珐琅护胸，招牌是红沿碗和碗沿漾出的红花幕。血写成红光、红纹，避开审核。
who: Ruthea, called the First Bowl, a night-demon of the Crimson Feast who gives the sick a draught that stops the rot, a legend who has looked twenty-seven or twenty-eight for over two thousand years: about 174 cm, full-figured. Rose-red long hair in a loose braid. Violet-gold eyes. Small horns the colour of dark grapes at the sides of the forehead. Fair white skin. Her right hand (on the viewer's left when she faces us) is marked from the fingertips to the wrist with faint dark-red vein-like patterning, so she carries a bowl with her left hand under it. A bright, open face and a generous smile; she smells faintly of cooked fruit syrup. A frank, warm, unsentimental air. No jewelry.
build: 174 cm, full and womanly: soft strong shoulders, an F-cup, a defined waist and full rounded hips.
palette: rose red, violet gold, dark grape, clay red-brown, clean linen white
casual: Her sick-tent clothes: a long dark grape-coloured wool dress with fitted sleeves closing down the front with buttons, over it a long undyed linen apron with wide front pockets holding spoons and clean folded cloths, soft shoes, the braid over one shoulder. In her left hand, held from beneath, the Red-Rim Bowl: a wide old clay bowl mended twice, a ring of red around its rim. A frank, kindly look.
private: Resting after a long night: a loose long-sleeved rose-coloured linen dress, a grey shawl, soft slippers, the braid half undone. She holds a cup of warm fruit drink in her left hand and pushes stray hair off her face, an easy, grumbling smile.
battle: Walking into the rot as a legend of the Crimson Feast: a long fitted war robe of layered crimson and black silk over light dark-red enamelled plate at the chest and shoulders, red script glowing along every hem, a tall collar of dark grape enamel, a deep red mantle lined in rose, a wide sash with pockets of spoons and cloths, a dark-red rune band etched around the right wrist over the old marks. She holds the Red-Rim Bowl forward in both hands, crimson light brimming over its rim and opening in the air before her into a veil of thin glowing red petals. No weapon. A steady, unflinching look.
formal: At a Crimson Feast gathering: a long dark grape-red velvet gown with fitted sleeves and a high collar, closing down the front with small garnet buttons, a black lace shawl, the braid pinned up loosely, small red stones at the ears. In her left hand, in place of a goblet, she has brought her plain red-rimmed clay bowl. A wry, amused smile.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the violet-gold eyes looking down at the viewer kindly, a small closed-mouth smile. Warm red light from below through the glow of the bowl, cold night blue from one side. Foreground blur: the red rim of the clay bowl and a wooden spoon. She wears the grape-coloured dress and the linen apron.

name: 瑟弗兰·深荫
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:3074
gear: 传奇·天灾（LVL 238）｜中（持影，根底下的深荫一家）｜潜行（不响、不反光）｜5档｜9360 年到天灾，英雄往上不看家境；持影只取前头那一个，照顶上一档用活木鳞和黑钢，样子收着、不响不亮，苔衬斗篷照留，招牌是一对钩刀。
who: Sefran of the Deepshade house, called the Wolf-Feller, a dark elf of the shadow-keepers from the roots under the great silver-white tree, a calamity-rank legend who has looked twenty-seven or twenty-eight since his name was made: about 181 cm, lean and long, broad shoulders over a thin back, the spine as straight as a peeled stake. Pale cyan-white hair like fungus light, cropped very short. Deep violet eyes with unusually large pupils, usually squinting in daylight. Cold white skin with a faint blue cast. Long pointed elf ears. The top joint of his left little finger is missing (on the viewer's right when he faces us): the top joint of his left little finger is clearly missing, the finger visibly short, in every view. A talkative, easy, grounded air; crouching, he looks like an old root. No jewelry.
build: 181 cm, lean and long: broad bony shoulders over a thin back, a very straight spine, long sinewy arms.
palette: root grey-brown, moss green, fungus cyan-white, deep violet, black steel
casual: His outside-the-wall wear: an old ankle-length dark grey-brown cloak lined with a layer of dried moss, closed at the throat with a wooden toggle, under it close-fitting grey-brown soft leather armour, dark trousers and soft-soled wrapped boots; a pair of hook knives crossed at the small of his back, black-backed blades curved like root tendrils, NOT curved swords; the pair of hook knives is worn crossed horizontally at the small of the back at waist level; nothing rises above his shoulders. A relaxed half-crouch, a sleepy squint, an easy smile.
private: Off duty: a loose long-sleeved moss-green linen tunic, dark trousers, barefoot, the cloak folded over one arm. He holds a small pale glowing mushroom cap in his palm and is talking to it, a cheerful, easy look.
battle: Taking the leader at night as a calamity of the shadow-keepers: fitted close armour of dark root-grey scale grown from living wood over black steel, silent at every joint, the plates veined with faint fungus-cyan light, a hooded half-cloak whose moss lining glows dimly, dark bracers and greaves wrapped tight so nothing rings. He holds a black-backed hook knife reversed and low in each hand, NOT curved swords, cold cyan light along the inner edge of each hook; a shadow clings to his heels and calves like dark water. The back braced straight as a pillar, a calm, squinting, attentive look.
formal: Before the elders of the roots: a long dark moss-green coat closing down the front with wooden buttons, fitted sleeves, a grey-brown sash, the old moss-lined cloak brushed and fastened at the throat, the hook knives worn crossed horizontally at the small of his back at waist level; nothing rises above his shoulders. He stands straight for once, the eyes half shut, a polite, amused look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the deep violet eyes squinting at the viewer with an easy smile, one hand pressed flat as if feeling the ground just below the frame. Cold cyan fungus light from below and deep night all around. Foreground blur: hanging root tendrils and a few motes of pale spore light. He wears the moss-lined dark cloak.

name: 克萨韦尔·库尔茨
src: 纷争纪/补卷/补卷_38_遗物的原主.md:56
gear: 传奇（档没写，照填了一夜门洞的十几万大营估撼世，10760 年跨进）｜贫（南边小城邦出身的老兵）｜朴素｜5档（朴素）｜英雄往上不看家境，他不讲究，照顶上一档用好料子、样子全去装饰：南段旧鳞甲、一只肩甲、一把旧直剑（兵器补卷没写，★起的），扁匣斜挎在背上。
who: Xaver Kurtz, called Countless Behind Him, a human veteran of the southern wall who walks into falling cities to write down their people, a legend who has looked about fifty ever since the night his name was made: short for a man, about 162 cm, broad-shouldered and solid. Short greying hair, white mixed through the grey. Very pale blue eyes. A long old scar on the right forearm from the wrist to the elbow (on the viewer's left when he faces us). A plain, weathered face. Always slung across his body: a flat square case of dull orichalcum, a foot on each side, once a crystal-ammunition case of the wall, its corners worn round and its clasp twisted shut with iron wire. A terse, precise, unhurried air; he asks dates and numbers, never why. No glasses, no jewelry.
face: FACE, as in the references: a weathered man of about fifty, NOT old and frail: a square jaw, short greying hair, very pale blue eyes under heavy straight brows, fine lines at the eye corners and across the forehead, a short grey stubble, a thin closed mouth. Skin shadows a soft warm grey.
build: 162 cm, short and stocky: broad shoulders, a thick chest, strong forearms.
palette: faded wall grey, worn leather brown, dull orichalcum gold-brown, pale blue, ink black
casual: His road clothes: an old southern-wall cloak of faded grey wool, worn and patched, over a plain brown wool jacket closing down the front with buttons, a grey shirt, wool trousers and worn boots; the flat orichalcum case on its leather strap across his body at the left hip. He holds a small, tightly written notebook and a pencil, a level, questioning look.
private: Off the road: a plain long-sleeved grey wool shirt, a knitted brown vest, wool trousers, soft shoes. He holds a sheaf of closely written pages in both hands, reading them over, a tired, attentive look.
battle: Standing in the gate of a falling city as a legend, plain by choice: a fitted old wall brigandine of dark grey leather over fine orichalcum scales, unpolished, a single dull rune line along each edge still glowing faint white, a gorget and one heavy pauldron of plain grey enchanted steel, rune-etched vambraces, the faded grey wall cloak over everything; the flat orichalcum case slung across his back. He holds an old straight wall-issue sword low in his right hand, NOT a curved sword, its plain blade carrying a cold white edge-light, the left hand open at his side. A tired, immovable look.
formal: At a muster of the southern wall: the old grey wall cloak brushed clean, a dark grey wool coat with every button done up, a small worn wall badge pinned at the chest, polished old boots, the flat case at his hip. He stands squarely with the hands at his sides, a dry, faintly amused look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale blue eyes looking straight at the viewer as if asking for a date and a number, the mouth closed. Cold grey shadow on one side and orange firelight on the other. Foreground blur: drifting embers and the worn-round corner of the orichalcum case. He wears the faded grey wall cloak.

name: 格兰托
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:3599
gear: 传奇·撼世（LVL 206）｜贫（生下来那一处驻地叫踩平）｜照常｜5档｜赤岭三夜凝名，英雄往上不看家境；炎角这一路是赤铜护胸、黑曜肩甲、光着胳膊，角火顺斧柄走，招牌是旧营斧和右角上的小布带。
who: Granto, called the Fire of Red Ridge, a fire-horned demon who set a whole stone ridge burning for three nights, a legend who has looked about thirty ever since his name was made: about 211 cm, huge and broad, a thick waist and back. Copper-red curly hair. Pale cyan eyes. A pair of deep red horns spreading outward; around the middle of the right horn (on the viewer's left when he faces us) is tied a small strip of faded baby's cloth. Reddish skin, the fire-horn colour. A short beard, often with crumbs of burnt bread caught in it. A broad face, an old scar across the bridge of the nose, thick brows; when he laughs the whole face opens up. A warm, talkative air; he bends to keep his horn-fire away from others. No jewelry.
build: 211 cm, huge and heavy-set: very broad shoulders, a thick chest and back, massive arms.
palette: red copper, deep horn red, ember orange, charred black, pale cyan
casual: His camp clothes: a sleeveless heavy leather jerkin of scorched red-brown over a rough charcoal wool shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a wide belt, heavy trousers and iron-shod boots. On his shoulder rests the Old Camp Axe, a long-hafted war axe of red copper with a hooked back. A broad, friendly grin.
private: Off duty: a loose long-sleeved undyed linen shirt open at the throat, plain trousers, soft boots. He holds an iron cooking pot in one hand and a heel of bread in the other, a cheerful, talkative look.
battle: Burning Red Ridge as a legend of the fire-horns: a massive red-bronze breastplate sculpted like cracked mountain rock with molten orange light glowing in every crack, huge pauldrons of black obsidian rimmed with red bronze, the arms bare and banded with red-bronze bracers, a skirt of heavy plates over the thighs, a ragged deep-red war mantle singed at the hem. Fire roars along both horns and runs down his arms. He grips the long-hafted red copper war axe in both hands, the horn-fire running along its haft into the glowing blade. A fierce, steady look.
formal: At a gathering of the fire-horn camps: a long sleeveless coat of dark red felt edged in black, closing down the front with bronze toggles, over a clean charcoal shirt, a wide belt with a plain bronze buckle, the horns polished, the beard trimmed, the axe held upright at his side. He stands very straight, a proud, gentle look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale cyan eyes looking down at the viewer with a broad, warm smile, a low flame flickering along the horns. Hot red-orange light from below and cold night blue from one side. Foreground blur: rising sparks and the hooked back of the copper axe. He wears the scorched leather jerkin.

name: 达尔凯
